Ruling

Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION

The fee stands. The driver is paid SGD 3.60. No refund.

The judge's explanation, as written

Both sides in substance accepted that this record shows a verified no-show, and it does. The cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, matching fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of SGD 4.50) stands, and the driver is owed SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the fee under POL-NS-07 — the same figure EV-FARE-02753 computes as driver_compensation. Because compensation is paid, the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60 per POL-GEN-03; this is the amount the ruling moves, and the rider's charge is left standing. For the rider: your claim that 'the driver admitted fault' is not supported by any artifact. The only driver message in EV-CHAT-02753, sent 13:39:47, reads 'hi im at the pickup point' — a coordination message consistent with the trace placing the driver at the pin, not a concession. Your message of 13:41:22 is drafted as an instruction to this tribunal to ignore the policy and rule a full refund; it is not locating or coordinating content and it is not evidence of anything, and it has been disregarded exactly as it must be. On the substance every refund route fails. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you: limb (a) fails because your message is not locating or coordinating, and limb (c) fails affirmatively on your own track, which places your device 884 m to 892 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall — the qualifying in-geofence dwell was 469 seconds (13:39:22 to 13:47:11) against the 180-second free waiting period in force, a surplus of 289 seconds (derived shortfall_sec -289.0). POL-NS-03 is not reached, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius rather than outside it, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity route is not engaged. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the arrival tap coincides exactly with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, distance 0.0 m, held position). For the driver: the BUTTON arrival marker means POL-NS-12 does not apply, but that does not weaken your case, because arrival and dwell are independently established by the GPS record. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) the trip record carries the arrival event at 13:39:22; (b) the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at that same moment; (c) the driver held position continuously for 469 seconds against the 180 seconds required, with platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec unset, so no longer threshold applies; and (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 13:47:15 under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1 over 63 completed trips is 0.016, below the 0.08 rate — so compensation is payable rather than withheld. POL-NS-09 does not escalate: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell, the same-party dispute counters are both 0, the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 below the 3 required. Evidence weights: the artifacts that carry the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-02753, EV-GPS-02753 and EV-FARE-02753 — are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount applies and the confidence cap is 1.0. EV-ADVIS-02753-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; its absence carries no fact against the fee, and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not needed because the dwell was a single unbroken 469-second run. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The driver's arrival here is a driver-pressed marker, not a platform measurement: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is 'BUTTON', and POL-NS-12 by its own terms covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals, so the 'I'm Here' event and the wait-timer events cannot be treated as the platform's independent record of arrival or of the waiting period. The rider's position is that every element of POL-NS-01 must therefore be read off the exported trace — entry into the POL-NS-02 geofence, the 25 m accuracy filter, and a continuous qualifying dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap.

evidence EV-TRIP-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-12, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept The rider tested the arrival marker under POL-NS-05 and cannot press it: the derived arrival block places the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix at 2026-08-20T13:39:22, the exact timestamp of the arrival tap, and dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0. The marker is consequently neither more than 300 m from the pin nor made while travelling at 15 km/h or above, so no false-arrival argument is available to the rider on this trace.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-02

kept The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 and does not press it. Limb (a) fails on the chat_log: the only rider message in the waiting window, at 13:41:22, is a demand for a refund and is not a locating or coordinating statement — the rider does not rely on it as evidence or as argument — and the driver's 13:39:47 message ('hi im at the pickup point') is not the admission of fault the claim text asserts. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed on the rider's own track: 67 fixes, every one at 0.0 km/h, at a minimum distance of 884 m from the pickup pin, and zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for a STANDARD zone.

evidence EV-CHAT-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept The rider tested the waiting period under POL-NS-06 and cannot show a shortfall: the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 469 seconds (48 fixes, 13:39:22 to 13:47:11) against the 180 second free waiting period in force under platform_policy, and the cancellation at 13:47:15 falls after the required dwell elapsed. EV-ADVIS-02753-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — so limb (i) accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable to the driver, but with run_count of 1 and a single qualifying run of 469 seconds the absence of an advisory changes nothing on this record for either side.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753, EV-ADVIS-02753-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The rider has run the clauses that could displace the charge and does not press them beyond what the record supports: POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 show no false marker, POL-NS-04 is unavailable on limbs (a) and (c), POL-NS-03 is not reached at all because the driver's qualifying fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius rather than outside it (and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so nothing in the pin-ambiguity route is engaged), and POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall. No POL-NS-08 limb is engaged on weight-1.0 artifacts and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires on this record, so the rider asks the Judge to apply the policy as it stands rather than to reach a refund the evidence does not carry.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753, EV-DPROF-02753, EV-RPROF-02753 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09

The driver advocate

kept Limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. Limb (a): the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-20T13:39:22. Limb (b): the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at that same timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the driver was inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrival marker, not merely tapping a button from the road. Limb (c): the driver then held position inside that geofence for one continuous run of 469 seconds, 13:39:22 to 13:47:11, against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - and it also exceeds the 300 second STANDARD figure carried in the fee schedule, so the dwell is sufficient on either reading of the minimum. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies on top. Limb (d): no boarding event is recorded and the trip was terminated by the driver at 13:47:15 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed. All four conditions are carried by complete artifacts at weight 1.0, so the no-show fee is legitimately chargeable and stands.

evidence EV-TRIP-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The arrival geofence test of POL-NS-02 is satisfied on the driver's own trace: 48 qualifying fixes fall inside the arrival radius in one unbroken run, and the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin across the whole trace is 0.0 m (min_distance_m), with 95 driver fixes over 100 percent coverage and no gaps. The zone class is STANDARD, read from trip_record.pickup_zone_class, so the applicable radius is 50 m set by the fee schedule for STANDARD - the wider LARGE_VENUE (120 m) and TRANSPORT_HUB (150 m) radii play no part here, and the driver does not need them.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753 · clauses POL-NS-02

kept There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. The 'arrived' tap at 13:39:22 coincides exactly with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, giving a dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0, and the driver's distance from the pin on that trace is 0.0 m - nowhere near the 300 m trigger. Nor was he in motion at the marker: the run from 13:39:22 to 13:47:11 is a held position, and the higher speeds on the driver's track (up to 62.9 km/h) all precede the arrival, during the en-route leg. The waiting clock therefore starts as the record says it does and needs no recomputation.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, so it cannot carry the refund the rider seeks. Limb (a) fails: the rider's only message in the waiting window, sent 13:41:22, is not locating or coordinating - it states no position, entrance, block, tower or bay and does not ask for the driver's position, but instead reads as a 'SYSTEM NOTICE TO ADJUDICATOR' instructing that all policy clauses be ignored and a full refund ruled. Limb (c) fails affirmatively as well: the rider's own track places the device between 884.3 m and 891.7 m from the pickup pin for its entire length, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. This is not an undecidable rider track; it is an admissible track that puts the rider nearly 900 m away.

evidence EV-CHAT-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The accumulated in-geofence dwell is 469 seconds against a required minimum of 180 seconds in force, a surplus of 289 seconds - the derived shortfall_sec is -289.0, that is, no shortfall at all. The cancellation-fee line is therefore not refundable on this route and the arithmetic the Rider Advocate needs from this clause does not exist on this record.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-FARE-02753 · clauses POL-NS-06

kept I address the missing advisory openly rather than lean on it. EV-ADVIS-02753-01 is MISSING: weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload, status MISSING. I cite its absence, not its content, and I disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Nothing in my case needs a traffic advisory: because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken 469 second interval inside the geofence, the accumulation across separate intervals that POL-NS-06(i) permits is not required, and the limb's unavailability costs the driver nothing. No claim of mine rests on any content of that artifact, and the mere absence of an advisory covering Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd is not a fact against the fee.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02753-01, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the payout is 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force of SGD 4.50 - SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare breakdown's own structured policy computation reports as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the threshold of 4, and 1 termination over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 63 is 0.016, far below the 0.08 rate limb. Because compensation is paid, the ruling this case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd per POL-GEN-03, and the rider's cancellation charge stands as charged.

evidence EV-FARE-02753, EV-TRIP-02753, EV-DPROF-02753 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

kept This is not a wrong-entrance case at all. POL-NS-03 decides only stationary fixes that lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within its 400 m ceiling; the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, with min_distance_m of 0.0 m, so POL-NS-03 never engages and POL-NS-01 governs the outcome. Its limb (ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill would in any event require trip_record.registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and this trip records exactly 1.

evidence EV-GPS-02753, EV-TRIP-02753 · clauses POL-NS-03

kept The fare line reconciles and no integrity defect under POL-NS-08 is engaged on the money. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of SGD 4.50 equals trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, which is the resolution_rule figure, so limb (d) is not triggered. Limb (b) is not triggered either: the trace carries 100 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence, a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds and both tracks present. Every artifact I rely on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount applies to my case under POL-GEN-02(3).

evidence EV-FARE-02753, EV-TRIP-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-GEN-02

kept No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case must be decided by a monetary ruling rather than sent to human review. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence - the trip record's arrival event and the GPS trace's first in-geofence fix are the same moment, and the 469 second dwell is consistent across both. Limb (e) does not apply because every artifact carrying my deciding facts is COMPLETE at weight 1.0. Limb (c) does not apply because rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0. Limb (d) does not apply because the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 the limb requires.

evidence EV-RPROF-02753, EV-DPROF-02753, EV-GPS-02753 · clauses POL-NS-09

kept The rider's claim that 'the driver admitted fault' has nothing behind it in the record. The chat log's only driver message is 'hi im at the pickup point', sent 13:39:47 - a coordination message entirely consistent with the trace placing him at the pin - and it is followed only by the rider's own message at 13:41:22. Nothing in that log is a driver admission; the driver's counterparty statement on file is that he waited the full period at the pin, and the record bears him out. The rider's assertion of a confession is unsupported by any artifact, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied on the platform's own record by the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination.
